errors.evidence: The description states the y-axis range is from 0.80 to 1.05, but the axis labels clearly show the range starts at 0.75.
The description claims the line has no special marker shapes, but the plot clearly shows circular markers at each data point.
In the year 2002, the value on the line is approximately 0.97, not 0.95.
In the year 2004, the value on the line is approximately 0.96, not 0.97.
In the year 2006, the value on the line is at a local peak of approximately 1.00, not 0.94.
In the year 2008, the value on the line is approximately 0.99, not 0.98.
In the year 2010, the value on the line is approximately 0.96, not 0.95.
The description claims the value remains around 0.96 until 2014, but it incorrectly simplifies the trend, ignoring a significant rise to a peak of approximately 0.99 in 2012 before falling back.
In the year 2016, the value on the line is approximately 0.96, not 0.91. The value reaches 0.91 around the year 2020.
